items.source_text:
QUESTION 1 Identity verification
Follow each instruction carefully.
1. Open your passport to the page with your photo.
2. Hold the passport in front of your face for 3 seconds, then move the passport next to your face.
(No more than 20 cm away from your face)
3. Read the following words out loud:
Hocus-pocus, Jibber-jabber, Babbling
This helps us to confirm your ID. Once you have finished, click Stop Recording to go to the next step.
